model.name: FeatureManager.profileUuidOf
model.description: profileUuidOf(token): FORWARD resolver — map an allowedUsers token to its ior:class:User/Profile scenario-unit REAL uuid (model.uuid, e.g. Marcel Donges 37fcb752, distinct from the token). Used by allowedUsersChildren (subtitle + child ref = the profile uuid, keeping the raw token out of URL-addressable refs) and grantedUserProfile (id row). REPLACES + RETIRES userIdOf(sha256[:16]) — no opaque hashing. LOAD-BEARING marked decl (#126). Architect round-3 design 0cd05131a.
